title: Chapter 2901 - 159: Twenty
content:
Chapter 2901: Chapter 159: Twenty-Four Patterns

"Do you recognize it?" Mo Hua asked Wujiu Great God.

"It is..." Wujiu Great God’s expression was somewhat inexplicably surprised and complicated, "...It’s the Holy Beast of the Great Wilderness."

Mo Hua slightly frowned.

This Wujiu Great God, why does he like to talk nonsense so much? Who doesn’t know this Pixiu is the Holy Beast of the Great Wilderness?

Stumbling over his words, he must be hiding something.

Mo Hua turned his head again, pointed at Wujiu Great God, and asked Pixiu, "Do you recognize this bird feather?"

Bird feather...

Wujiu Great God dared not express his anger.

Pixiu shook its large head, obviously not knowing the background of this "birdman" in front of it, but its eyes were full of joy and excitement.

Pixiu is stingy, guarding its wealth.

These existences in the Divine Thought, heavenly demons or evil gods, once they enter its gate, they become its "treasures."

Recently, within a short time, it has obtained another treasure—how could it not be happy?

Divine Beasts, like deities, have equally long lifespans, so their sense of time is quite "dull." Years may have passed outside, but this big-headed Pixiu didn’t feel like much time had passed.

It even simply took a few naps.

And after taking a few naps, its "good friend" unexpectedly came to see it again, bringing something good along.

Even though Pixiu is stingy and guards its treasure, it has a generous disposition and doesn’t hold grudges easily.

It has long forgotten about Mo Hua’s fists pounding its big head.

Also forgot about the little "tiff" between them.

Pixiu rubbed its big head against Mo Hua, then drooled, looking at the body of Wujiu Great God.

Wujiu Great God, who had been in a state of shock, only now reacted, his heart skipped a beat, and turned around to flee.

But before running far, Mo Hua grabbed him by the wings, twisted them off, lifted him up, and threw him in front of Pixiu.

Mo Hua said generously:

"I’m giving him to you."

Pixiu’s copper-bell-like eyes flashed with joyful light.

It gladly accepted the gift.

There’s just one issue, the gifts it has received from Mo Hua are a bit too many, it always feels somewhat "weighed down."

Pixiu lifted its left paw, revealing the Little Faceless Celestial Demon underneath.

Wujiu Great God, whose wings had been twisted off, saw this faceless, featureless, otherworldly demon creature, his pupils trembled.

The Little Faceless Celestial Demon, upon witnessing daylight, began to howl and struggle.

Silly Pixiu then realized its left paw was already occupied.

With a slap, it again pushed the Celestial Demon down, then lifted its right paw, which revealed another True God Embryo with a whole body of evil qi.

This True God Embryo, upon appearing, emanated an ancient evil qi that made all creatures in the hall uneasy.

Wujiu Great God was just shocked by the existence of the Celestial Demon, uncertain and fearful, when suddenly he saw another Divine Fetus, his face changed dramatically.

He pointed at the True God Embryo of the Evil God, incredulous, and said, "This...this is..."

Mo Hua said, "It should be a Divine Fetus incubated by your Divine Lord."

Wujiu Great God stared dumbfounded at Mo Hua, his face full of terror.

This Little Divine Monarch...what is his background?!

This place he occupies, what kinds of... monsters are imprisoned here?!

Mo Hua said, "You’ll be confined here from now on."

Wujiu Great God, who originally felt very angry and humiliated, suddenly fell silent.

After a moment, he looked at Mo Hua, somewhat uncertainly asking a question:

"Do I really... deserve it?"

Do I really deserve to be confined with the Celestial Demon and a True God Embryo of such Ancient Gods?

Mo Hua pondered for a moment, nodded and said:

"According to strength, you don’t deserve it. But you came early, thus able to secure a spot, in the future, you too will be a ’senior.’ From this aspect, you do deserve it."

Wujiu Great God was stunned for a moment, then slowly nodded, unexpectedly finding it reasonable.

Clearly being "sealed" and suppressed, yet inexplicably, there arises within his heart a newfound sense of... "honor."

As if being sealed by Mo Hua was a recognition, a kind of divine "honor."

Meanwhile, the True God Embryo of the Evil God sensed Mo Hua’s aura, its eyes suddenly grew pitch black, filled with fierce hatred, glaring at Mo Hua, wishing to devour his flesh, swallow his bones.

Mo Hua seemed completely indifferent.

The big-headed Pixiu was a bit annoyed, though; his "pet" dared to get angry at his "good friend"?

With a big paw slap, it pressed down the True God Embryo once more.

The True God Embryo could not struggle.

Pixiu lifted its left rear paw and found the space beneath it empty, then let out a howl towards Mo Hua.

Mo Hua understood its intention and placed Wujiu Great God under Pixiu’s left rear paw.

Pixiu pressed down with its hind paw, holding Wujiu Great God as well.

Thus, its four paws were pressing down "treasures" with three of them.

The big-headed Pixiu, seemingly fulfilling an important mission granted by nature, felt very "complete," appearing satisfied.

Yet, Mo Hua recalled the appearance of the True God Embryo of the Evil God, as if in contemplation.

Since this Evil God True Embryo entered the Great Wilderness, Mo Hua had not come to see it.

Firstly, too busy to attend to other matters.

Secondly, as the Great Wilderness is the Master of the Great Wilderness’ domain, Mo Hua feared triggering some Cause and Effect.

But now, seeing this Evil God True Embryo so "orderly," even when in the Great Wilderness, there was no unusual behavior.

This is indeed suspicious.

Mo Hua thought for a bit, then asked Pixiu:

"Big head, can I cut a piece of meat?"

Who knew that the originally nice-looking Pixiu suddenly got angry, its mood changing faster than flipping a book, baring its teeth at Mo Hua furiously.

But halfway through its anger, Pixiu’s fury faded, its big eyes carried some guilt.
